# Destinations for Japan

## Tokyo
### Must-do
| Name | Area | Why it fits (food, temples) | Crowd tactic | Rating (count) | Price level | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Senso-ji | Asakusa | Tokyo's most iconic temple, matches "temples" like | Peak site, included because must-do. Arrive 06:30, before shops and tour groups open | 4.6 (98,971) | n/a | tool |
| Meiji Jingu | Shibuya, 1-1 Yoyogikamizonochō | Forest-set shrine, calm walk to the main hall, fits "temples" like | Arrive 07:00 at gate opening, before tour buses reach the inner shrine | 4.7 (52,991) | n/a | tool |
| Gotoku-ji | Setagaya, 2-chome-24-7 Gotokuji | Quiet "lucky cat" temple, far fewer visitors than the big-name sites | Instead of Senso-ji's inner grounds for a second temple, come here, it stays quiet all day | 4.6 (10,969) | n/a | tool |
| Zojo-ji | Shiba, 4-chome-7-35 Shibakoen | Large temple near Tokyo Tower, calmer than Senso-ji or Meiji Jingu | Arrive 08:00, before the Tokyo Tower crowd spills over | 4.5 (12,734) | n/a | tool |

### Food areas
| Area | What to eat | Best time | Crowd tactic | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tsukiji Outer Market (Tsukiji Donburi Ichiba, Tsukiji Fish Market) | Fresh seafood donburi, grilled skewers, tamagoyaki | Early morning, 07:00-09:00 | Arrive before 08:00, before tour groups and lunch lines | tool |
| Yurakucho Yakitori Alley | Grilled chicken skewers under the train tracks | Early evening, 17:30 opening | Go right at opening on a weekday, before the after-work rush | tool |
| Shibuya Tokyu Foodshow | Depachika bento, wagashi, bakery items | Weekday lunch, 11:00-13:00 | Weekday over weekend, the basement food hall gets packed after 18:00 | tool |
| Asakusa food alleys (Nakamise Shopping Street, Kappabashi Hondori) | Ningyo-yaki, senbei, age-manju on Nakamise, kitchenware and sample-food shops on Kappabashi | Nakamise before 09:00, Kappabashi late morning on a weekday | Walk Nakamise at opening, before 09:00, then shift to Kappabashi (mostly a wholesale street, never crowded), rather than fighting the midday Nakamise crush | tool |
| Asakusa izakaya row (Hoppy Street / Okamoto Hoppy Street) | Grilled offal (motsuyaki), Hoppy malt drink, simple izakaya plates | Early evening, from 16:00 opening | Go right at the 16:00 opening on a weekday, seats at the outdoor tables fill fast after 18:00 | tool |
| Yanaka Ginza | Menchi-katsu croquettes, senbei, skewered dango, neighbourhood snacks | Mid-afternoon, 14:00-16:00 | Weekday mid-afternoon, well before the sunset photo crowd gathers at the Yuyake Dandan steps | tool |
| Ueno food street (Ameyoko Market) | Street seafood, cheap sushi, fresh fruit, fried snacks | Late morning on a weekday, 10:00-12:00 | Weekday late morning avoids the weekend shoulder-to-shoulder crowds along the main arcade | tool |
